product_one_liner.value: Vertical Insure provides embedded insurance technology and operations that let vertical SaaS platforms offer tailored coverage within their existing customer workflows.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation/footer has no pricing link, and the /pricing URL is a not-found page.

named_customers.notes: The closest case-study index identifies the named organizations as platform partners; I did not find two named end-customer organizations that meet the instruction to exclude partners.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists 53 employees, which falls in the 51-100 band.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn gives the headquarters as Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States.

founded_year.notes: LinkedIn lists Vertical Insure as founded in 2022.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index lists editorial articles about insurance and vertical-software business topics, not engineering posts explaining how the product is built; its older-entries URL currently returns a not-found page.

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal has multiple guides, API reference material, and integration articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open job board lists eight roles; none has AI, ML, data science, or a related title.

model_provider.notes: A public case study says Vertical Insure rebuilt its location-intelligence system using OpenAI models; this identifies the provider for that risk-assessment use, not necessarily every product feature.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy policy has a GDPR-compliance section, and the developer docs say payment handling is PCI-compliant; no claim of SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA was found. The PCI wording does not specify an attestation type.

last_funding.notes: The funding profile reports the latest round as $21 million Growth Equity on August 4, 2026; the company announced the Updata Partners financing that day.

raised_18mo.notes: The company announced new financing on August 4, 2026, within the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live board lists an Enterprise Account Executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: On October 23, 2026, Vertical Insure announced a new embedded probate-bond workflow with EstateMin, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A profile lists Ryan Kasprzak as Chief Underwriting Officer at Vertical Insure beginning April 2026, inside the 12-month window ending 2026-11-09.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Enterprise Account Executive posting explicitly says the role uses HubSpot CRM.
